title: arenaria gayana
intro: Arenaria gayana, commonly known as Sea Pink or Sandwort, is a small, flowering plant that belongs to the Caryophyllaceae family. It is native to the coastal regions of Europe, North Africa, and Western Asia, and is often found growing in sandy, well-drained soils. The health benefits of Arenaria gayana include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate wound healing, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
